requiredGates.detail: Vanilla 85 > P1 84. v0.5 package cannot claim product quality improvement.
OpsFlow Enterprise Lite is insufficient. Larger benchmark needed to test generalization.
AGENT-9-P2/P3 explicitly state CONDITIONAL, not default.
AGENT-9-P2 evidence: P1 process 80 vs Vanilla 40, evidence 82 vs 45.
AGENT-5-P1 repaired all known policy defects.
P1 runtime is proven for 13-module project only. Needs larger validation.
No v0.5 package manifest exists. Would need CORE_PACKAGED/Optional/DEPRECATED classification.
v0.5 release requires explicit user approval.

minimumForUnblock: Second benchmark PASS on larger project (>50 modules)
P1 product quality >= Vanilla on that benchmark OR
Explicit user decision to release as PROCESS_TOOL (not product quality tool)
experimentalPackAlternative: P1 runtime could be released as FACTORY-AGENT-RUNTIME-P1-EXPERIMENTAL (non-default, no product quality claim). This is a separate gate from v0.5 release.
